We are looking for a highly driven Global Campaign Lead to own the strategy and execution of global campaigns across the platform.

This role requires a deep understanding of crypto markets, exchange products, trading users, and user lifecycle, combined with strong market sense across TradFi and global assets. q: 5+ years of experience in growth, campaign operations, user operations, or related roles, preferably in crypto exchanges, fintech, brokerage, or trading-related businesses.
Proven experience in user lifecycle operations , with a strong understanding of activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell, and reactivation.
Deep understanding of the crypto industry, exchange products, trading mechanics, and user behavior.
Active trading experience , with a genuine habit of exploring different products, trading tools, and strategies.
Strong market sense across Crypto and TradFi, with the ability to connect market conditions, user needs, and product opportunities.
Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and evaluate incremental business impact.
Proven ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional projects in a fast-moving organization.
Strong ownership, ambition, and resilience, with the ability to perform under pressure and take responsibility for results.
Fluent in both English and Chinese as working languages.
Based in or willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE.
We value people who trade, understand users, stay close to the market, and get things done.

You should understand who the user is, where they are in their lifecycle, what the market is doing, and what product they need next — and be able to turn that understanding into campaigns that drive real business growth.

d: The Welding Foreman is responsible for supervising and coordinating welding activities at fabrication shops and project sites. The role ensures that all welding work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved procedures, project specifications, quality standards, and schedules.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in welding and fabrication works, including supervisory experience
Strong knowledge of welding processes such as SMAW, GTAW, GMAW, FCAW, and SAW
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, isometric drawings, and welding symbols
Experience in structural steel, piping, tanks, pressure vessels, or industrial projects is preferred
Good leadership and team management skills
Familiarity with quality standards, welding procedures, and inspection requirements
r: Supervise and lead welders, fabricators, and welding helpers on site
Plan, assign, and monitor daily welding activities to achieve project targets
Ensure welding work is performed according to approved drawings, specifications, and welding procedures
Coordinate with Engineers, Supervisors, QA/QC Inspectors, and Site Management to ensure smooth project execution
Monitor productivity, workmanship, and material utilization
Inspect work progress and ensure compliance with quality and safety requirements
Ensure proper use, maintenance, and storage of welding machines, tools, and equipment
Conduct toolbox talks and enforce company HSE policies and procedures
Identify and resolve welding-related issues and technical challenges
Maintain daily manpower allocation, attendance, and progress records
Verify that all welders possess valid qualifications and certifications where required
Assist in material planning and coordinate fabrication and installation activities
Ensure work areas are maintained in a clean and safe condition
